dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (Nihon Igikai standard receipt system), compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux. Program ORCHC02V02 is a prescription/receipt printing component (A5 format).
evidence: no EXEC CICS / no EXEC SQL

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance receipt (shinryo-hoshu seikyu) printing system — prescription slip printing for outpatient/inpatient medical care under Japan's national health insurance scheme
purpose.summary: ORCHC02V02 is a batch COBOL program that prints medical prescription receipts (A5 format) for the JMA ORCA standard receipt software system. It handles insurance combination data, drug/procedure line items, patient information, and various Japanese health insurance rule changes across many revision levels from 2002 to 2015.

notable_features: 345 PERFORM statements indicating structured procedural logic
Japanese EUC/Shift-JIS encoded comments (latin-1 decoded with mojibake)
OCCURS clauses for insurance combination and drug line arrays
REDEFINES used for numeric/display conversion of quantities
No COMP-3 packed decimal despite financial/medical domain
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS — flat file I/O only
Extensive revision history spanning 2002–2015 in comments
FD PRT-FILE with PIC X(10000) large record for print output
verdict.notes: File decoded as latin-1 but comments are Japanese EUC or Shift-JIS, appearing as mojibake in this encoding. This is definitively the JMA ORCA open-source medical receipt system, a well-known Japanese healthcare COBOL application. Source is truncated at 16000 chars out of 234178 bytes (5473 lines total); classification is based on the visible portion plus mechanical indicators.
